root_cause.text: The local pointer variable `wa` in `ccp_run_aes_gcm_cmd` was incorrectly annotated with the `__cleanup(kfree)` attribute instead of `__free(kfree)`, causing the stack address of the pointer itself to be passed to `kfree` upon scope exit instead of the allocated heap memory address.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff replaces `} *wa __cleanup(kfree) = kzalloc(sizeof *wa, GFP_KERNEL);` with `} *wa __free(kfree) = kzalloc(sizeof(*wa), GFP_KERNEL);` in `drivers/crypto/ccp/ccp-ops.c`, and the description notes that `__cleanup(kfree)` "will make the address of the local variable, rather than the address returned by kmalloc, passed to kfree directly and lead to a crash due to invalid deallocation of stack address."
